blocks.content: The Election Commission of India (ECI) is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering elections in India. It ensures that elections are conducted in a free, fair, and impartial manner.
The Election Commission of India (ECI) is an autonomous constitutional authority responsible for administering elections in India.

items: ECI is a constitutional body, not a statutory or extra-constitutional authority.
The mandate of ensuring 'free, fair, and impartial' elections is a key constitutional principle often questioned in polity exams.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Election Commission of India (ECI) is an autonomous constitutional authority.
Its core mandate is administering elections across India.
It operates to ensure all elections are conducted in a free, fair, and impartial manner.
